g.title: G
Initial notar votes. Meaning: These are signed first votes for the exact block B. Purpose: At 60% stake they establish ordinary notar support. At 80% they establish fast finality.
Fast-final certificate. Meaning: At least 80% stake sent initial notar votes for B. Purpose: This proof alone finalizes B. There is no separate fast-final vote.

C01: At least 80%. When: Initial notar votes for B reach at least 80% stake. Action: Build a fast-final certificate for B. Reason: This threshold supplies enough correct initial support for the one-round finality proof.

a.xlink:title: This threshold supplies enough correct initial support for the one-round finality proof.
C01: At least 80%

g.title: Ordinary notar certificate. Meaning: At least 60% stake sent initial notar votes for B. Purpose: The certificate permits eligible final votes and helps establish a parent. By itself, it does not finalize B.

C02: At least 60%. When: Initial notar votes for B reach at least 60% stake. Action: Build an ordinary notar certificate for B. Reason: The certificate proves initial support. It permits eligible validators to send final votes.

a.xlink:title: The certificate proves initial support. It permits eligible validators to send final votes.
C02: At least 60%

g.title: Votes for a fallback certificate. Meaning: This group can include initial notar votes and notar-fallback votes for the same block B. Purpose: The certificate counts each validator once. A combined 60% can make B usable as a parent.
g.text: Initial or fallback votes for B

g.title: Notar-fallback certificate. Meaning: At least 60% distinct stake supports B through initial or fallback notar votes. Purpose: This proof can make B a parent. It cannot replace the ordinary notar certificate in two-round finality.

C03: At least 60% distinct. When: Initial and fallback votes for B together cover at least 60% distinct stake. Action: Build a notar-fallback certificate for B. Reason: The certificate allows B to serve as a parent when ordinary notar support was insufficient.

a.xlink:title: The certificate allows B to serve as a parent when ordinary notar support was insufficient.
C03: At least 60% distinct

g.title: Votes for a skip certificate. Meaning: This group can include initial skip votes and skip-fallback votes for the same slot. Purpose: A combined 60% permits a later block to pass this slot. Each validator counts once.

Skip certificate. Meaning: At least 60% distinct stake supports a skip through initial or fallback skip votes. Purpose: It permits a later block to pass the slot. The final chain ultimately determines which slots it omits.

C04: At least 60% distinct. When: Initial and fallback skip votes together cover at least 60% distinct stake. Action: Build a skip certificate. Reason: The certificate permits a later leader to use a parent before this slot.

a.xlink:title: The certificate permits a later leader to use a parent before this slot.
C04: At least 60% distinct

g.title: Final votes. Meaning: These votes sign the slot number. Correct senders first notar-voted its block and then saw an ordinary notar certificate. Purpose: Their commitment to stop fallback support supplies the second round of finality.
Final certificate. Meaning: At least 60% stake sent FinalVote for the slot. Purpose: The validator also needs the ordinary notar certificate to identify the block and establish two-round finality.

C05: At least 60%. When: Final votes for the slot reach at least 60% stake. Action: Build a final certificate for the slot. Reason: The certificate proves enough final-vote commitments for the two-round path.

a.xlink:title: The certificate proves enough final-vote commitments for the two-round path.
C05: At least 60%

g.title: C13: Also meets notar proof. When: A fast-final certificate proves at least 80% initial notar stake. Action: Treat that evidence as meeting the weaker 60% notar requirement. Reason: A group of at least 80% also meets a threshold of 60%.

a.xlink:title: A group of at least 80% also meets a threshold of 60%.
C13: Also meets notar proof

g.title: The block is final. Meaning: A valid fast certificate or the required two-round certificate pair establishes finality for B. Purpose: Both paths give the same final decision. Local execution and root advancement can finish later.
C06: Accept fast finality. When: The validator accepts a valid fast-final certificate for B. Action: Mark B as final. Reason: The 80% certificate alone meets the one-round finality rule.

a.xlink:title: The 80% certificate alone meets the one-round finality rule.
C06: Accept fast finality

g.title: C12: Also meets fallback proof. When: An ordinary notar certificate already proves at least 60% support for B. Action: Treat that proof as sufficient for uses that need a notar-fallback certificate. Reason: Initial notar votes are permitted inputs to a notar-fallback certificate.

a.xlink:title: Initial notar votes are permitted inputs to a notar-fallback certificate.
C12: Also meets fallback\nproof

g.title: Check this validator’s final vote. Meaning: An ordinary notar certificate causes BlockNotarized. The handler checks its own first vote and state flags. Purpose: Only an initial notar voter for the same block, without BadWindow or ItsOver, can send a new FinalVote.

C07: Try own final vote. When: The validator accepts an ordinary notar certificate for B. Action: Record BlockNotarized. Check the local final-vote conditions. Reason: The certificate supplies the group evidence that a correct final voter needs.

a.xlink:title: The certificate supplies the group evidence that a correct final voter needs.
C07: Try own final vote

g.title: Both finality proofs available. Meaning: The validator has the ordinary notar certificate for B and the final certificate for the same slot. Purpose: One certificate identifies block support. The other proves the final-vote commitments. Together they establish two-round finality.

C08: Store notar proof. When: The validator accepts the notar certificate for B. Action: Use it with the final certificate, if that certificate is available. Reason: The notar certificate identifies the block that the slot-only final certificate refers to.

a.xlink:title: The notar certificate identifies the block that the slot-only final certificate refers to.
C08: Store notar proof

g.title: Check parents for another window. Meaning: A parent certificate or skip certificate adds evidence to the ParentReady tracker. Purpose: The tracker needs a supported parent and skip permission for every gap before the new window.

C14: Parent has enough support. When: The validator has a notar-fallback certificate, or stronger evidence, for B. Action: Check whether intervening slots have the required skip certificates. Reason: A supported block can serve as a parent only when the next window can connect to it.

a.xlink:title: A supported block can serve as a parent only when the next window can connect to it.
C14: Parent has enough\nsupport

g.title: C15: One more gap has proof. When: A new skip certificate arrives. Action: Check whether it completes the required sequence of skip certificates. Reason: The next leader needs permission to pass every slot between its parent and its window.

a.xlink:title: The next leader needs permission to pass every slot between its parent and its window.
C15: One more gap has proof
a.text: C15: One more gap has proof

g.title: C09: Store final proof. When: The validator accepts the final certificate for the slot. Action: Use it with the ordinary notar certificate, if that certificate is available. Reason: The final certificate proves commitments but does not contain the block identity by itself.

a.xlink:title: The final certificate proves commitments but does not contain the block identity by itself.
C09: Store final proof

g.title: C10: Accept two-round finality. When: Both valid certificates refer to the same slot. The notar certificate identifies B. Action: Mark B as final. Reason: The pair supplies both block support and final-vote commitments.

a.xlink:title: The pair supplies both block support and final-vote commitments.
C10: Accept two-round\nfinality

g.title: The earlier chain is decided. Meaning: A final block fixes its parent chain. Its ancestors are final, and earlier slots outside that chain are decided skips. Purpose: Parent references connect the new final decision to the earlier history.
g.text: Gaps in that chain are decided skips

g.title: C11: Decide the earlier chain. When: Block B becomes final. Action: Finalize its ancestors. Decide omitted earlier slots as skips. Reason: B identifies one parent chain. A final decision for B fixes that earlier chain.

a.xlink:title: B identifies one parent chain. A final decision for B fixes that earlier chain.
C11: Decide the earlier\nchain
